task.spec:
I would like you to implement a module named TopModule with the following
interface. All input and output ports are one bit unless otherwise
specified.

 - input clk
 - input d
 - input q

The module should implement a single D flip-flop. Assume all sequential
logic is triggered on the positive edge of the clock.
task.constraints:
SystemVerilog, exactly one self-contained TopModule DUT. Inline all helper logic inside TopModule; do not define auxiliary modules. xczu3eg-sbva484-1-e; 5 ns synthesis clock; simulator seed 1. No reference dependencies, hierarchy outside the DUT, file access, includes or DPI.
Public interface erratum (p10-public-interface-031-v1): The public prompt lists q as input, but requires a positive-edge D flip-flop. Interpret q as a one-bit output; clk and d remain one-bit inputs. This approved interface correction overrides only that port-direction typo; the original prompt is preserved.
